node.statement: Use node 1.2.1 for the membership premise (r_j in C for every j and r in C) and node 1.2.2 for the coefficient premise (c_j >= 0, 1-s > 0, and sum_j c_j + (1-s) = 1). With these premises declared, the list r_1,...,r_m,r with weights c_1,...,c_m,1-s is a finite convex combination of points of C. Since C is convex, that convex combination lies in C; by the definition of r_star, this point is r_star, hence r_star in C.
